Setting PA = PO and squaring gives (x−10)² + (y+10)² = x² + y², which simplifies to −20x + 20y + 200 = 0, so x − y = 10.

Substituting y = −x + 6 gives x − (−x + 6) = 10, so 2x = 16, x = 8, and y = −2. Thus P = (8, −2).

Check: PO² = 64 + 4 = 68 and PA² = (−2)² + 8² = 4 + 64 = 68, so the distances are equal.
